results.detail: The selected groups have no fresh measured balance at T.
results.findings:
No measured history

The selected categories do not have usable observations in this ledger. This cannot establish a zero market or a zero return.

No growth comparison

A change needs measured balances at both dates. No percentage is inferred from missing observations.

Keep dated disclosures separate

Later product disclosures remain available in Other carry and Data. They cannot fill this historical series without matching the date and denominator.

Look at the same protocols, too

The constant cohort holds 64 protocol rows fixed across all 24 months and T. All-observation growth can reflect a new claim or new coverage; it cannot by itself establish deposits.

The strategy label has limits

Carry parents contribute 501,340 ETH equivalent at T. Their monthly category history follows a consistent protocol mapping; dollar-sleeve weights, rewards and debt are measured separately. Basis remains unmeasured in this ledger.
